svg.title: All-in-one capture
svg.desc: The All-in-one toolbar opens over a frozen screen. A region is dragged out, locked to 16:9 and captured to the Quick Access card. Then Text mode reads the link in a QR code, and Colour mode picks the blue of a chart bar with a magnifying loupe.

g.text: Last deploy 12 minutes ago · all checks passed
Drag over an area, or click a window. Enter captures.
Drag over text or a code to copy it.
Click a pixel to copy its colour.
